responsibility: Implements summary objects for reusing previously analyzed function behavior at later call sites. It describes call_summary instances from terminal exploded nodes, including user-facing summary descriptions derived from return-state information, and defines call_summary_replay, which maps callee summary svalues, regions, and bindings back into the caller’s region_model so summarized effects can be replayed instead of re-entering the callee.
same_name_distinction: Implements the concrete behavior of the call_summary and call_summary_replay interfaces from call-summary.h, especially summary description generation and the runtime remapping/replay of summary svalues, regions, and bindings into a caller state.
